title: Pay the full nearlinear finite-word tour-sampling contract on bidirected multigraphs
statement: Pair opposite labelled arcs of the BIDIRECTED graph into distinct undirected edges, discarding loops only for the tree stage. Spanning trees orient uniquely toward the smallest-arc tail and correspond bijectively to its inward directed trees. Use the accepted cographic down-up/UST walk: choose a non-tree edge, choose an edge uniformly on its fundamental cycle, and exchange. Fixed T=O(h log((h+1)/delta)),h=|E(H)|-n+1, mixes from any tree; h=0 is unique. Deterministic-amortized link-cut forests and array non-tree selection pay every operation sequence. Replace each uniform integer choice by floor(k Z/2^b) with b=O(L), total conditional TV<=epsilon/3 across fixed T+O(m) draws; charge ideal mixing and fixed-bit Fisher–Yates errors separately. BEST completion fixes the smallest arc first, tree exits last at nonroots and reconstructs a valid tour on EVERY run, with unconditional entire-law TV<=epsilon and work/randomness/memory O((n+m+B)L^c). Empty and loop-only singletons are handled explicitly. This is a full BIDIRECTED positive result via mature UST/BEST machinery, not the asymmetric target.
